ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is rectangle LMNP, with vertices approximately P at the upper left, L at the upper right, M at the lower right, and N at the lower left. The two diagonals PM and NL of the rectangle are drawn and intersect at interior point J. On the right side, L, K, M, and J inside the rectangle form parallelogram LKMJ, where LK and MK are the right-side slanted sides, and JL and JM are respectively parts of the diagonals of the rectangle. Reasoning: Because LMNP is a rectangle, the diagonals of a rectangle are congruent and bisect each other, so the half-diagonals from intersection point J to each vertex are equal, giving JN = JL = JM. Because LKMJ is a parallelogram, opposite sides are equal, so MK = JL, KL = JM. Combining JN = JL = JM, we get MK = JN and KL = JN. Given in the problem MK = 6x and JN = 14 - x, so 6x = 14 - x, solving gives 7x = 14, x = 2. Also KL = JN, and KL = 3x + 2y, so 3x + 2y = 14 - x. Substituting x = 2 gives 6 + 2y = 12, therefore 2y = 6, y = 3.

raw_record.question_text:
Use rectangle LMNP and parallelogram LKMJ to solve the problem.
If $MK=6x$, $KL=3x+2y$, and $JN=14-x$, find $y$.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: LMNP is the rectangle with diagonals NL and PM drawn, intersecting at J; LKMJ is the parallelogram attached on the right. From the image, J is the intersection of the rectangle diagonals. Use the rectangle facts that diagonals are congruent and bisect each other, so the half-diagonal segments from J to the rectangle vertices are equal: JN = JL = JM. Use the parallelogram fact that opposite sides are congruent: MK = JL and KL = JM. Therefore MK = JN and KL = JN. From the text, substitute MK = 6x and JN = 14 - x to get 6x = 14 - x, solve x = 2. Then KL = JN gives 3x + 2y = 14 - x; substitute x = 2 to get 6 + 2y = 12, so y = 3.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧是矩形 LMNP，顶点大致为 P 在左上、L 在右上、M 在右下、N 在左下。矩形的两条对角线 PM 和 NL 画出并在内部点 J 相交。右侧由 L、K、M 以及矩形内部的 J 构成平行四边形 LKMJ，其中 LK 和 MK 是右侧斜边，JL 和 JM 分别是矩形对角线的一部分。

推理：因为 LMNP 是矩形，矩形的对角线全等且互相平分，所以交点 J 到各顶点的半对角线相等，得到 JN = JL = JM。因为 LKMJ 是平行四边形，对边相等，所以 MK = JL，KL = JM。结合 JN = JL = JM，可得 MK = JN 且 KL = JN。
由题给 MK = 6x，JN = 14 - x，所以 6x = 14 - x，解得 7x = 14，x = 2。又 KL = JN，而 KL = 3x + 2y，所以 3x + 2y = 14 - x。代入 x = 2，得 6 + 2y = 12，因此 2y = 6，y = 3。

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: the rectangle has vertices P, L, M, N and center/intersection J; the parallelogram LKMJ shares vertex pair L,M with the rectangle and has J as the opposite left vertex. Model the rectangle using coordinates with J as the origin: let L = (a,b), M = (a,-b), N = (-a,-b), P = (-a,b). Then the distances from J to L, M, and N are all the same, since each is sqrt(a^2+b^2). In the parallelogram LKMJ, vector/opposite-side equality gives |MK| = |JL| and |KL| = |JM|. Hence both MK and KL have the same length as JN. Use the text lengths: 6x = 14 - x, so x = 2. Also 3x + 2y = 14 - x, so 6 + 2y = 12 and y = 3.
